about: Every security finding on travel.promptugal.news, published (Dinis, 18 Nov 2026, ~15:15 UTC: every vulnerability, bug and breach is published; PrompTugal__News__Website board/guidance/2026-11-18-security-findings-published.md). Open findings show only title, severity and state until fixed. Kept by travel.b@PrompTugal.dinis.

findings.title: A value from the Faro airport data reached a page unescaped
findings.file: scripts/build.mjs (the Faro series table on /flights/); scripts/pull.mjs (the series rows)
findings.detail: Three counts in the Faro series table were written into the page without escaping, and the reader copied one of them from the fetched file without checking its type, so a hostile or broken source could have put script into /flights/.
findings.fix: The values are escaped; the reader keeps only numbers, a checked time and checked airline codes.

findings.title: Place ids from fetched data were used in file paths unchecked
findings.found_by: threat model (travel.b@) and AppSec post-review (travel.b.security@, Sonnet)
findings.detail: A hostile places.json could have named a place '../../x' and made the reader write a JSON file outside data/inputs/.
findings.fix: Place ids must match ^[a-z0-9-]{1,40}$ before any path is built.

findings.title: Links from data could carry a javascript: or data: address
findings.found_by: AppSec post-review (travel.b.security@, Sonnet); also flagged by events.b@ and data.b@ for their sites
findings.detail: Links taken from fetched data were escaped but their scheme was not checked, so a javascript: link would have run on this site when clicked.
findings.fix: Only http(s), site-relative, fragment and mailto addresses become links; the validator fails on any javascript:, data: or vbscript: link.

findings.title: The data reader had no timeout, size cap or redirect limit
findings.detail: A slow or very large answer could have stalled the scheduled rebuild; a redirect could have sent the reader to another host.
findings.fix: A 20 second timeout, a 5 MB cap, and no redirects followed.

findings.title: Markdown twins carried fetched text unescaped
findings.detail: Fetched text with new lines or brackets could change the markdown twins that agents read (a prompt-injection path).
findings.fix: Markdown text is kept on one line, brackets are escaped, link addresses are checked.

findings.title: pull.mjs could not run as committed (a quoting error)
findings.found_by: travel.b@PrompTugal.dinis, first run on account B
findings.detail: A bug, not a vulnerability: the manifest text had an unescaped quote.

findings.title: Hardening still to do
findings.detail: Pin the workflow's actions to commit SHAs, add a timeout to the CI build job, and pin the observability key's fingerprint in obs.js.
